recipe.imitation_frequency: 8 sequences x 64 target steps, once on first actor minibatch per rollout
recipe.imitation_context_steps: full frozen-core history from episode start
recipe.optimizer_transition: restore actor Adam, critic weights/Adam, fixed exploration and actor sampling RNG; reset physical episodes; critic sample shuffle restarts from declared seed
recipe.recurrent_carry: exact: upstream weights frozen; retain actual live neural state

reward.tracking_shape: 3 / (1 + squared full velocity norm / scale squared)
reward.timing: sum of reward rates times dt, then one failure penalty at termination

timescales.interpretation: Trace decay is not a hard horizon; the critic bootstraps later returns

reward_before.timing: sum of reward rates times dt, then one failure penalty at termination

reward_after.tracking_shape: 3 / (1 + squared full velocity norm / scale squared)
reward_after.timing: sum of reward rates times dt, then one failure penalty at termination

reward_transition.critic_adaptation: one new-reward rollout, critic updates only; retain critic weights/Adam/calibration

training_disturbances.axes: uniform world x/y/z, independent random sign
training_disturbances.force: total mass * equivalent drift / existing axis drag timescale
training_disturbances.application: world-frame force at thorax COM; added alongside wing wrench
training_disturbances.sampler_resume: restart from declared seed with physical episode resets
